text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan and Grass-chan really are both 
amazing!

—This year's "Arima Kinen." Special Week, 
Grass Wonder, and many other notable 
contenders were running.

Among such a stacked lineup, just Haru 
Urara being able to run in the race was 
amazing in itself.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I did my best! I did, but...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Mmmh... Ya know, I feel just a little 
weird.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I gave it my best and it was fun, but... 
hmmm?

She seems a bit perplexed, unable to put 
her current feelings into words.

"Perhaps this is a chance to pin down that 
vague 'something' Haru Urara is feeling 
right now. If so—"
choice_data_list:
If I run one more time, maybe I'll figure 
it out

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean, one more time...? The 
Arima Kinen?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I see, you're right! If I don't get it, I 
should just run and see!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I want to run in the Arima Kinen 
one more time~!

The reason she couldn't win this time 
surely lies within the lingering 
frustration Haru Urara is feeling.

"Then I want to train her thoroughly for 
one more year, and let her challenge the 
Arima Kinen with a fresh mindset."
choice_data_list: Then, we gotta win a graded race.
Then, we have to win a graded race.

text_block_list.text:
For Haru Urara to run in the Arima Kinen 
again, her only option is to win graded 
stakes races and raise both her popularity 
and her skill.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Umm~... So I just have to run in these 
"Graded" races?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Sure thing! After all, I love running!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I can't wait for the Arima Kinen! I 
wish next year would hurry up and get 
here♪

"...I'll believe in Haru Urara's 
determination." With that, our training in 
the Classic Year came to an end.
